en: Black‑and‑white view of a large neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance style castle or palatial villa on a slope, partly obscured by trees and shrubs. The building has crenellated rooflines, several cylindrical corner turrets with battlements, and a central clock tower. Arched windows with shutters line the façades. The foreground is a grassy hillside, and there is no visible caption or border text on the image side.
